title: Current-Fed Push-Pull Resonant Converter
description: Current-fed push-pull resonant DC-DC converter (100 kHz) with a resonant transformer tank and behavioral ideal-diode output rectifier. Boosts 12 V to roughly 24 V into a 5.76 ohm load.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: push_pull_resonant.qsch is Alonso's schematic; push_pull_resonant.cir is the self-contained QUX netlist (his behavioral library inlined) plus a single '.options cshunt=1e-12' line added for convergence (the ideal-switch resonant tank otherwise aborts with 'Timestep too small'). The 1 pF node shunt is negligible at 100 kHz.

workflows.title: Current-Fed Push-Pull Resonant Converter -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files into the workspace and simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
